subject: DataFlow Inc — Renewal Proposal for MegaCorp
body:
Hi team,

Please find our renewal proposal for the DataFlow platform license.

Proposed terms:
- Annual rate: $380,000 per year (down from list price of $450,000)
- Commitment: 3-year term
- Start date: March 1, 2025

This represents a 15.5% discount from our standard rate in recognition of MegaCorp's long-standing partnership. The 3-year commitment is required to unlock this pricing.

Please let me know if you have any questions.

Best,
Alex Morgan
Account Executive, DataFlow Inc

subject: Re: DataFlow Inc — Renewal Proposal for MegaCorp
body:
Alex,

Thank you for the proposal. We are reviewing internally. The 3-year term is longer than our standard commitment. We will revert shortly.

Regards,
MegaCorp Procurement

subject: Re: DataFlow Inc — Renewal Proposal for MegaCorp
body:
Team,

I have reviewed the DataFlow proposal. Here are the approved terms:

- Annual rate: $380,000 per year (accepted)
- Term: 2 years ONLY — we will not commit to 3 years at this time
- Start date: March 1, 2025
- Total contract value: $760,000

Alex, please confirm these terms and send a revised contract reflecting the 2-year commitment. The 3-year term is not approved.

Legal — please update the contract management system accordingly. The current entry of $450,000/year is incorrect.

Jane
VP of Procurement, MegaCorp

subject: Re: DataFlow Inc — Renewal Proposal for MegaCorp
body:
Jane,

Confirmed. We accept the 2-year term at $380,000 per year. Revised contract to follow.

Alex

subject: Contract system update — DataFlow
body:
Hi,

I updated the DataFlow contract in the system. I used the original proposal amount of $450,000/year as I could not find the final approved figure. Please verify.

Thanks

subject: CloudVault — NovaTech License Agreement Final Terms
body:
Hi NovaTech team,

Following our negotiations, here are the final agreed terms for the CloudVault platform license:

- Annual license fee: $425,000 per year (15% discount from $500,000 list price)
- Term: 2 years
- Total contract value: $850,000
- Payment: Annual in advance

This discount reflects NovaTech's commitment to a 2-year term and our strategic partnership.

Please confirm acceptance so we can proceed to contract execution.

Best,
Sarah AE
CloudVault Inc

subject: Re: CloudVault — NovaTech License Agreement Final Terms
body:
Sarah,

Accepted. $425,000 per year for 2 years, total $850,000. Finance — please raise a PO for $850,000 against this agreement.

Thanks,
VP of Sales, NovaTech

subject: Re: CloudVault — NovaTech License Agreement Final Terms
body: PO raised for $850,000 as instructed. PO number: NVT-2025-0892.
